title: Complete the installer and first-work campaign proof
text: The corrected welcome refusal captured successfully but still needs independent inspection. Hosted startup then refused a complete verification URI because the old gate rejected its matching user_code query. Source now validates the URI/code pair and declared origin, with six recovery recipes and the first-work mission. Agent-mode setup (yoke setup --agent) and the installer's terminal-less hand-off to it ship in source with focused tests; a live harness run where an agent relays each setup question to a person is still owed. Full campaign, live-session delivery and first-item done evidence remain required; valid coordinates do not establish approval authority. See docs/testing-verification/installer-campaign.md.
